<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en" class="scroll-smooth">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<link rel="icon" href="data:image/png;base64,">
<title>Flow Zenix - AI, SEO & Creative SaaS Suite</title>
<script src="https://cdn.tailwindcss.com/3.4.17"></script>
<script>
tailwind.config={theme:{extend:{colors:{brand:{50:'#eef2ff',400:'#818cf8',500:'#6366f1',600:'#4f46e5',700:'#4338ca',900:'#312e81',950:'#1e1b4b'}},fontFamily:{sans:['Inter','system-ui','sans-serif']}}}}
</script>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@400;600;800&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
:root{box-sizing:border-box;padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);padding-bottom:env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px)}
body{font-family:'Inter',system-ui,sans-serif}
.glass-card{background:rgba(255,255,255,.03);backdrop-filter:blur(12px);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1)}
.light .glass-card{background:rgba(255,255,255,.9);border:1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.08)}
.light{background:#f8fafc;color:#0f172a}
.light .text-white{color:#0f172a}
.no-scrollbar::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}
@keyframes spinWheel{to{transform:rotate(1800deg)}}
.spinning{animation:spinWheel 4s cubic-bezier(.15,.95,.15,1) forwards}
</style>
</head>
<body class="bg-slate-950 text-slate-100 antialiased" id="bodyRoot">

<header class="sticky top-0 z-40 backdrop-blur-md bg-slate-950/80 border-b border-slate-800">
<div class="max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 h-16 flex items-center justify-between">
<div class="flex items-center gap-3 cursor-pointer" onclick="switchView('landing')">
<img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Flow Zenix" class="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl object-cover">
<div><span class="text-lg font-extrabold bg-gradient-to-r from-white to-brand-400 bg-clip-text text-transparent">Flow Zenix</span><span class="block text-[10px] text-brand-400 font-semibold">flowzenix.shop</span></div>
</div>
<nav class="hidden md:flex items-center gap-8 text-sm font-medium">
<a href="#pricing" onclick="switchView('landing')" class="text-slate-300 hover:text-brand-400">Packages</a>
<a href="#catalog" onclick="switchView('landing')" class="text-slate-300 hover:text-brand-400">Tool Catalog</a>
<button onclick="switchView('dashboard')" class="text-slate-300 hover:text-brand-400">📊 Dashboard</button>
</nav>
<div class="flex items-center gap-2">
<button onclick="openSpinModal()" class="px-3 py-2 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-r from-amber-500 to-orange-500 text-white font-bold text-xs">🎁 Spin & Win</button>
<button onclick="toggleTheme()" class="w-9 h-9 rounded-full border border-slate-700 text-sm">🌓</button>
<button onclick="toggleMobileMenu()" class="md:hidden text-xl p-2">☰</button>
</div>
</div>
<div id="mobileMenu" class="hidden md:hidden px-4 pb-4 border-t border-slate-800 bg-slate-900/95 space-y-2">
<a href="#pricing" onclick="toggleMobileMenu()" class="block py-2 text-slate-300">Packages</a>
<a href="#catalog" onclick="toggleMobileMenu()" class="block py-2 text-slate-300">Tool Catalog</a>
<button onclick="toggleMobileMenu();switchView('dashboard')" class="block py-2 text-slate-300">My Dashboard</button>
</div>
</header>

<main>
<div id="landingView">
<section class="relative pt-14 pb-20 overflow-hidden text-center px-4">
<div class="absolute top-1/3 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 w-[500px] h-[500px] bg-brand-600/20 blur-[120px] rounded-full pointer-events-none"></div>
<div class="relative max-w-4xl mx-auto">
<div class="inline-block px-4 py-2 rounded-full bg-brand-500/10 border border-brand-500/20 text-brand-400 text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider mb-6">⚡ 89+ Premium AI, SEO & Creative Tools</div>
<h1 class="text-4xl sm:text-6xl font-extrabold leading-tight">Access 89+ Premium <span class="bg-gradient-to-r from-brand-400 to-purple-400 bg-clip-text text-transparent">AI, SEO & Creative Tools</span> Starting at ৳249</h1>
<p class="mt-5 text-slate-400 max-w-2xl mx-auto">আপনার প্রয়োজনমতো সাশ্রয়ী মূল্যে স্টুডেন্ট, ডিজাইনার, মার্কেটার বা অল-ইন-ওয়ান প্যাকেজে নিন ChatGPT, Canva Pro, SEMrush, Netflix এবং ৮৯+ প্রিমিয়াম টুলস!</p>
<div class="mt-8 flex flex-col sm:flex-row gap-3 justify-center">
<button onclick="openPaymentModal('All-in-One (৯১ টুল)','৳৪৪৯')" class="px-8 py-4 rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-r from-brand-600 to-indigo-600 text-white font-bold shadow-xl shadow-brand-600/40">Get All-in-One — ৳449 →</button>
<button onclick="openSpinModal()" class="px-8 py-4 rounded-2xl border border-amber-500/50 bg-amber-500/10 font-semibold text-amber-300">🎁 Spin & Win Discount</button>
</div>
</div>
</section>

<section id="pricing" class="py-16 max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4">
<div class="text-center mb-10">
<span class="text-brand-400 font-semibold text-sm uppercase">Flexible 1 Month Packages</span>
<h2 class="text-3xl font-extrabold mt-2">Choose Your Perfect Plan</h2>
<p class="mt-3 text-slate-400 text-sm">পেমেন্ট সম্পন্ন করার সাথে সাথেই অ্যাক্টিভেশন!</p>
</div>
<div class="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-5" id="plans"></div>
<div class="mt-8 glass-card rounded-3xl p-6 flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-center justify-between gap-4 border-amber-500/40">
<div><h3 class="text-lg font-bold">🧩 নিজের পছন্দমতো টুল নিন</h3><p class="text-slate-400 text-sm mt-1">১টা বা যতগুলো দরকার ততগুলো বেছে নিন — ১টা ৳২০০, ৪টা পর্যন্ত যেকোনো পছন্দমতো ৳২৯৯ — ৳৪৪৯ এর বেশি নয়।</p></div>
<a href="#catalog" class="px-6 py-3 rounded-xl bg-amber-500 text-white font-bold text-sm whitespace-nowrap">টুল বাছাই করুন ↓</a>
</div>
</section>

<section id="catalog" class="py-16 max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 border-t border-slate-800/60">
<div class="flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-end justify-between mb-8 gap-4">
<div><span class="text-brand-400 font-semibold text-sm uppercase">Comprehensive Inventory</span><h2 class="text-3xl font-extrabold mt-2">Explore Tool Categories</h2></div>
<input type="text" id="toolSearch" oninput="applyFilters()" placeholder="Search tools..." class="w-full md:w-80 px-4 py-3 rounded-xl bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 text-sm text-slate-200">
</div>
<div class="flex gap-2 overflow-x-auto pb-4 mb-6 no-scrollbar" id="categoryPills"></div>
<div class="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-5" id="toolsGrid"></div>
</section>
</div>

<div id="dashboardView" class="hidden py-8 max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4">
<div class="glass-card p-5 rounded-3xl mb-6 flex justify-between items-center">
<h1 class="text-xl font-bold">Welcome back, Subscriber!</h1>
<button onclick="switchView('landing')" class="px-4 py-2 rounded-xl border border-slate-700 text-sm font-semibold">Back to Home</button>
</div>
<div class="glass-card p-6 rounded-3xl"><div class="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-4" id="dashToolsGrid"></div></div>
</div>
</main>

<div id="cartBar" class="hidden fixed bottom-0 inset-x-0 z-40 items-center justify-between gap-3 px-4 pt-3 bg-slate-900/95 border-t border-brand-500/40 backdrop-blur" style="padding-bottom:calc(.75rem + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px))">
<span id="cartInfo" class="text-sm font-bold text-white"></span>
<div class="flex gap-2"><button onclick="clearCart()" class="px-3 py-2 rounded-xl border border-slate-700 text-xs">Clear</button><button onclick="checkoutCart()" class="px-4 py-2 rounded-xl bg-brand-600 text-white text-xs font-bold">Order Now</button></div>
</div>
<!-- Spin Modal -->
<div id="spinModal" class="fixed inset-0 z-50 hidden bg-slate-950/85 backdrop-blur-md items-center justify-center p-4">
<div class="glass-card max-w-sm w-full p-6 rounded-3xl relative border border-amber-500/40 text-center">
<button onclick="closeSpinModal()" class="absolute top-4 right-4 text-slate-400 text-xl">✕</button>
<span class="px-3 py-1 rounded-full bg-amber-500/10 text-amber-400 text-xs font-bold uppercase">Lucky Spin</span>
<h3 class="text-xl font-bold mt-2">Spin to Win!</h3>
<p class="text-slate-400 text-xs mt-1">আপনার ইমেইল দিয়ে স্পিন করে জিতে নিন বিশেষ ডিসকাউন্ট!</p>
<div id="emailInputBox" class="my-4"><input type="email" id="spinUserEmail" placeholder="আপনার ইমেইল এড্রেস লিখুন..." class="w-full px-4 py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-slate-900 border border-slate-700 text-sm text-center text-slate-200 focus:outline-none focus:border-amber-500"></div>
<div class="my-4 flex justify-center"><div id="spinWheelBox" class="w-40 h-40 rounded-full border-4 border-amber-500 bg-gradient-to-tr from-amber-600 via-brand-600 to-purple-600 flex items-center justify-center text-white font-extrabold"><span class="text-xs text-center">FLOW ZENIX<br>SPIN WHEEL</span></div></div>
<div id="spinResultBox" class="mb-4 hidden p-3 rounded-xl bg-amber-500/20 border border-amber-500/40 text-amber-300 text-xs font-bold"></div>
<button id="spinBtn" onclick="validateAndStartSpin()" class="w-full py-3 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-r from-amber-500 to-orange-500 text-white font-bold text-sm">Spin Now! 🎡</button>
</div>
</div>

<!-- Payment Modal -->
<div id="paymentModal" class="fixed inset-0 z-50 hidden bg-slate-950/85 backdrop-blur-md items-center justify-center p-4">
<div class="glass-card max-w-md w-full p-6 rounded-3xl relative border border-slate-700">
<button onclick="closePaymentModal()" class="absolute top-5 right-5 text-slate-400 text-xl">✕</button>
<h3 id="modalPlanTitle" class="text-xl font-bold">All-in-One</h3>
<p class="text-slate-400 text-sm mt-1 mb-5">Total Due: <span id="modalPlanPrice" class="text-white font-bold">৳৪৪৯</span></p>
<label class="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-400 uppercase mb-2">Select Payment Method</label>
<div class="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2 mb-5">
<button id="payBkashBtn" onclick="selectPaymentMethod('bkash')" class="p-3 rounded-xl border text-xs font-semibold">📱<br>bKash</button>
<button id="payNagadBtn" onclick="selectPaymentMethod('nagad')" class="p-3 rounded-xl border text-xs font-semibold">👛<br>Nagad</button>
<button id="payBinanceBtn" onclick="selectPaymentMethod('binance')" class="p-3 rounded-xl border text-xs font-semibold">₿<br>Binance</button>
</div>
<div class="p-4 rounded-2xl bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 mb-5 space-y-3">
<span id="gatewayTitle" class="text-xs font-bold text-slate-300">SEND MONEY TO BKASH</span>
<div class="flex justify-between items-center bg-slate-950 p-3 rounded-xl border border-slate-800">
<span id="gatewayNumber" class="font-mono font-bold text-white text-sm break-all">01911569897</span>
<button onclick="copyGatewayNumber()" class="px-3 py-1 rounded bg-brand-600 text-white text-xs ml-2">Copy</button>
</div>
<ol class="text-xs text-slate-400 space-y-1 pl-4 list-decimal"><li>বিকাশ বা নগদ থেকে টাকা পাঠিয়ে TrxID সংরক্ষণ করুন।</li><li>নিচের বাটনে ক্লিক করে WhatsApp-এ স্ক্রিনশট ও TrxID পাঠান।</li></ol>
</div>
<button onclick="sendToWhatsApp()" class="w-full py-3.5 rounded-xl bg-emerald-600 text-white font-bold text-sm">Send on WhatsApp</button>
</div>
</div>

function packHtml(title){
const names=title==='All-in-One'?uniq.map(u=>u.name):packTools[title];
return `<details class="mt-3"><summary class="text-xs text-brand-400 cursor-pointer font-semibold">${names.length}টি টুল দেখুন</summary><div class="flex flex-wrap gap-1 mt-2">${names.map(n=>`<span class="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md bg-slate-800 text-slate-300 text-[10px]">${n}</span>`).join('')}</div></details>`;
}
const PRICE_PER_TOOL=100,ALL_PRICE=449;
let cart=[];
function toggleCart(n){cart=cart.includes(n)?cart.filter(x=>x!==n):[...cart,n];applyFilters();updateCart();}
function cartTotal(){const n=cart.length;if(!n)return 0;if(n===1)return 200;if(n<=4)return 299;return Math.min(299+(n-4)*70,ALL_PRICE);}
function updateCart(){const b=$('cartBar');b.classList.toggle('hidden',!cart.length);b.classList.toggle('flex',!!cart.length);$('cartInfo').innerText=cart.length+' টি টুল • ৳'+cartTotal();}
function checkoutCart(){openPaymentModal('Custom Pack: '+cart.join(', '),'৳'+cartTotal());}
function clearCart(){cart=[];applyFilters();updateCart();}

iconHtml(n,sz){const i=ICONS[n];if(i&&i.u)return `<img src="${i.u}" alt="${n}" class="${sz} shrink-0">`;if(i)return `<div class="${sz} rounded-xl bg-white flex items-center justify-center p-2 shrink-0"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" class="w-full h-full" fill="${i.c}"><path d="${i.p}"/></svg></div>`;let h=0;for(const ch of n)h=(h*31+ch.charCodeAt(0))%360;return `<div class="${sz} rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center font-extrabold text-white shrink-0" style="background:linear-gradient(135deg,hsl(${h},70%,45%),hsl(${(h+40)%360},70%,35%))">${n[0]}</div>`;}
let activeCat='all';
const $=id=>document.getElementById(id);

$('plans').innerHTML=plans.map(p=>`<div class="glass-card p-6 rounded-3xl flex flex-col justify-between relative ${p[3]?'border-brand-500/60':''}">
${p[3]?'<div class="absolute -top-3 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 px-3 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-brand-600 text-white text-[10px] font-bold uppercase">Best Value</div>':''}
<div><div class="inline-block px-3 py-1 rounded-lg bg-slate-800 text-slate-300 text-xs font-semibold mb-4">1 Month Plan</div>
<h3 class="text-xl font-bold">${p[0]}</h3><p class="text-slate-400 text-xs mt-1">${p[2]}</p>
<div class="my-5"><span class="text-3xl font-extrabold ${p[3]?'text-brand-400':''}">${p[1]}</span><span class="text-slate-400 text-xs">/month</span></div>${packHtml(p[0])}</div>
<button onclick="openPaymentModal('${p[0]}','${p[1]}')" class="w-full py-3 rounded-xl ${p[3]?'bg-brand-600 text-white':'border border-slate-700'} font-semibold text-xs">Get ${p[0]}</button></div>`).join('');

function renderPills(){
const cats=['all',...new Set(toolsData.map(t=>t.cat))];
$('categoryPills').innerHTML=cats.map(c=>`<button onclick="filterCategory('${c}')" class="px-5 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-sm font-semibold whitespace-nowrap ${c===activeCat?'bg-brand-600 text-white':'bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 text-slate-300'}">${c==='all'?'All Categories':c}</button>`).join('');
}
function filterCategory(c){activeCat=c;renderPills();applyFilters();}
function applyFilters(){
const q=$('toolSearch').value.toLowerCase();
renderTools(activeCat==='all'?uniq.filter(t=>t.name.toLowerCase().includes(q)):toolsData.filter(t=>t.cat===activeCat&&t.name.toLowerCase().includes(q)).map(t=>({...t,desc:uniq.find(u=>u.name===t.name).cat})));
}
function renderTools(list){
$('toolsGrid').innerHTML=list.map(t=>`<div class="glass-card p-6 rounded-2xl">
<div class="mb-4">${iconHtml(t.name,'w-12 h-12')}</div>
<h3 class="text-xl font-bold text-white mb-2">${t.name}</h3><p class="text-slate-400 text-sm">${t.desc}</p><button onclick="toggleCart('${t.name}')" class="mt-4 w-full py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold ${cart.includes(t.name)?'bg-emerald-600 text-white':'border border-slate-700 text-slate-200'}">${cart.includes(t.name)?'✓ Added':'+ Add'}</button></div>`).join('')||'<p class="text-slate-400">No tools found.</p>';
}
$('dashToolsGrid').innerHTML=uniq.map(t=>`<div class="p-5 rounded-2xl bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 flex justify-between items-center">
<div class="flex items-center gap-3">${iconHtml(t.name,'w-9 h-9')}<div><h4 class="font-bold text-white text-sm">${t.name}</h4><span class="text-xs text-slate-400">${t.cats[0]}${t.cats.length>1?' +'+(t.cats.length-1):''}</span></div></div>
<button onclick="alert('Connected!')" class="px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-brand-600 text-white text-xs">Launch</button></div>`).join('');
renderPills();renderTools(uniq);

function switchView(v){$('dashboardView').classList.toggle('hidden',v!=='dashboard');$('landingView').classList.toggle('hidden',v==='dashboard');}
function toggleMobileMenu(){$('mobileMenu').classList.toggle('hidden');}
function toggleTheme(){$('bodyRoot').classList.toggle('light');}
function showModal(id){$(id).classList.remove('hidden');$(id).classList.add('flex');}
function hideModal(id){$(id).classList.add('hidden');$(id).classList.remove('flex');}

function openPaymentModal(t,p){$('modalPlanTitle').innerText=t;$('modalPlanPrice').innerText=p;showModal('paymentModal');selectPaymentMethod('bkash');}
function closePaymentModal(){hideModal('paymentModal');}
function selectPaymentMethod(gw){
const base="p-3 rounded-xl border text-xs font-semibold ";
const off=base+"border-slate-800 bg-slate-950 text-slate-400";
['Bkash','Nagad','Binance'].forEach(n=>$('pay'+n+'Btn').className=off);
const m={bkash:['payBkashBtn','border-pink-500 bg-pink-600/10 text-white','SEND MONEY TO BKASH','01911569897'],
nagad:['payNagadBtn','border-orange-500 bg-orange-600/10 text-white','SEND MONEY TO NAGAD','01911569897'],
binance:['payBinanceBtn','border-amber-500 bg-amber-600/10 text-white','BINANCE PAY ID / USDT ADDRESS','mohammedmokbul@gmail.com']}[gw];
$(m[0]).className=base+m[1];$('gatewayTitle').innerText=m[2];$('gatewayNumber').innerText=m[3];
}
function copyGatewayNumber(){try{navigator.clipboard.writeText($('gatewayNumber').innerText);}catch(e){}alert("Copied!");}
function sendToWhatsApp(){window.open(`https://wa.me/8801911569897?text=${encodeURIComponent(`I paid ${$('modalPlanPrice').innerText} for ${$('modalPlanTitle').innerText}.`)}`,'_blank');}

function openSpinModal(){
showModal('spinModal');$('spinResultBox').classList.add('hidden');$('emailInputBox').classList.remove('hidden');
$('spinUserEmail').value='';$('spinBtn').innerText="Spin Now! 🎡";$('spinBtn').onclick=validateAndStartSpin;$('spinBtn').disabled=false;
}
function closeSpinModal(){hideModal('spinModal');}
function validateAndStartSpin(){
const e=$('spinUserEmail').value.trim();
if(!e||!e.includes('@')||!e.includes('.')){alert('দয়া করে আপনার সঠিক ইমেইল এড্রেস লিখুন!');return;}
$('emailInputBox').classList.add('hidden');startSpin();
}
function startSpin(){
const w=$('spinWheelBox'),b=$('spinBtn'),r=$('spinResultBox');
b.disabled=true;w.classList.add('spinning');
setTimeout(()=>{w.classList.remove('spinning');r.classList.remove('hidden');
r.innerHTML='🎉 অভিনন্দন! আপনি পেয়েছেন ১০% ডিসকাউন্ট কুপন: <b>FZ-SPIN10</b>';
b.innerText="Claim 10% Off Now!";b.disabled=false;b.onclick=claimSpinDiscount;},4000);
}
function claimSpinDiscount(){closeSpinModal();openPaymentModal('All-in-One + 10% Discount','৳৩৯৯');}
</script>
</body>
</html>
